stage: V31 one-variable station-segment kernel development test
trigger: V30 mechanism diagnostics across both developed dates and BOARD/target roles identified station-segment heterogeneity as one candidate. Eleven route groups include ten descriptive improvements and the route-7 negative case; missing exact segment matches remain reported.

candidate.changed_variable: Physical station segment only; preserve route, event kind and scheduled-duration grouping.
candidate.segments: Travel uses connection departure-to-arrival stations; dwell/gap uses previous arrival-to-next departure stations. Dwell endpoints coincide. Use stable source station identities when graph-local integers differ by date.
candidate.estimate: For an observed segment group of size n, use n/(n+20) times its empirical elapsed law plus 20/(n+20) times the frozen V25 route/kind/schedule elapsed law.
candidate.tuning: Fixed once before candidate results. No alternative strengths, cutoff searches, variable additions or post-result subgroup selection.
candidate.missing_group: Use the existing V25 route kernel unchanged, including its existing pooled/residual fallback if that route group is absent.
candidate.eligibility: Same observed elapsed samples and official-journey identity rules as the frozen duration fit; use only the declared July 25 training date.
candidate.fixed: Initial/service laws, route priors, 20-second grid and existing projection, all 73 frozen menus, MCT, deadline, ideal public-event contract and control definitions.

forecast_test.population: All 151 existing unique V30 history/role/cid actions, including BOARD-only histories; evaluate the candidate against route_empirical20 on identical histories and actual labels.
forecast_test.primary_scope: V30 first_offer tag: 67 public histories and all their recorded fixed actions. Do not select by realized sign, candidate prediction or available final labels.
forecast_test.secondary_scope: V29 six frozen later divergences are reported separately; retain two wins and four losses.
forecast_test.metrics: Supported forecasts and known-label counts; matched first-arrival, remaining-wait, tail-wait and final-cost CRPS/error/coverage; legal_target_appears Brier; fixed-pair action differences.
forecast_test.primary_label_population: Use the same complete final-cost labels for both models; keep the ten missing final labels in the coverage ledger and identification ranges. No imputation or model-dependent case deletion.
forecast_test.exclusions: No new histories, target reselection in the fixed-forecast comparison, random worlds or independent-confirmation claim.

policy_test.population: Both policies on all 73 frozen roots; 48 origin and 25 first-transfer roots reported separately.
policy_test.comparison: Read the corresponding V28 route_empirical20 outcomes on the same root and objective. Do not rerun either old probability model.
policy_test.primary: Single-target mean truncated loss and arrival rate on all 48 origin roots.
policy_test.other_outputs: Keep the one-step comparison, conditional-transfer results, all per-root gains and harms, empty menus, unresolved trajectories and full local runtime.
policy_test.accounting: Record fitting/preparation/forecast/replay time for this development run. No full-system speedup claim from comparison to historical timing.

retain_gate.coverage: Candidate forecast support and actual-label coverage may not drop relative to route_empirical20; policy label coverage may not drop on the compared frozen roots. Missing is not converted to failure.
retain_gate.probability: Primary first_offer final-cost CRPS must be no worse overall and on each of July 16 and July 17; primary legal_target_appears Brier must be no worse overall, using matched labels.
retain_gate.action: All-48-origin candidate single-target mean loss must be no worse than V28 route_empirical20 single-target, and its arrival rate must be no lower. First-transfer roots do not offset origin losses.
retain_gate.comparison_tolerance: Only 1e-9 numerical tolerance for floating-score comparisons; no operational noninferiority margin is introduced.
retain_gate.failure: Any failed condition ends this station-segment correction attempt. Do not retune shrinkage or expand variables/menus/WAIT/BOARD planning.
retain_gate.success: Passing retains a modeling candidate for later independent confirmation only; it does not pass G2, establish significance or validate deployment.

limits: July 16 and 17 are developed retrospective dates, earlier than the July 25 training date; this is not prospective or independent confirmation.
Station heterogeneity was selected using development diagnostics. Its evaluation here is development evidence.
No new data downloads, new simulation worlds, large-menu DP or paper-method claim.
The V29 exact-scoring rescue remains stopped, regardless of this candidate's outcome.
